summary: Constructor-style zeroing initializer for a scorecard object. Clears three contiguous _WORD runs of the object: 286 words at this+0x8A, 30 words at this+0x97E, and 19 words at this+0xA72, then zeroes four _DWORD counters at this+0x1693/0x169B/0x169F/0x16A3 and sets the _WORD flag at this+0x48A to 1. Returns a pointer past the end of the cleared 0xA72 run. No reads, no globals, no callees.
